title: OPC UA Part 100 - Devices (DI)
catalogCoverage: sections 1-12 and annexes A-C read; 8.5, 8.6 and 8.7 not reached

rules.summary: BrowseNames of Nodes organized by one FunctionalGroup are unique
DeviceSet hierarchically reaches every ComponentType instance
Only the root instance of a complex Device hangs off DeviceSet
MethodSet is present only if it holds at least one Method
Every Network is a component of NetworkSet
Every ConnectionPoint is a component of its Device
Mandatory Properties of DeviceType are present on every instance
DeviceHealth is one of the five NAMUR NE107 values
A ProtocolType instance's BrowseName defines the Communication Profile
Clients use LockingServices for multi-step consistent changes
Well-known BrowseNames for standard FunctionalGroups
A hideable FunctionalGroup carries an appropriate ModellingRule
Common Attributes are set as Tables 7-9 specify
A ValueRank above zero requires ArrayDimensions to be specified
Methods defined by this specification are executable
References between two exposed Nodes are exposed as well
Non-server-specific Attributes and the NodeId are not writable
Operation counters only increase over the Device lifetime
Both ends of an IsOnline Reference are the same ComponentType subtype
A Device is the source of at most one IsOnline Reference
The TransferServices container has the BrowseName Transfer
Transfer Methods require a prior lock and return defined StatusCodes
The LockingServices Object is a component or AddIn of its lock owner
MaxInactiveLockTime is added to the ServerCapabilities Object
Locking Methods return defined StatusCodes and RenewLock resets the timer
A SoftwareUpdate AddIn attaches to an IVendorNameplateType implementer
The SoftwareUpdate AddIn uses the fixed BrowseName SoftwareUpdate
The nameplate Interface supplies the four Variables the update model needs
The Loading Object is present for every variation of software installation
Client obligations and Method-return semantics across the update model
A configurable Object holds a SupportedTypes folder organizing its Types
Configured instances are components of the configurable Object
Lifetime bound Properties share the DataType of the Variable's Value
WarningValues lie between StartValue and LimitValue
Nodes this specification does not define stay out of the standard namespaces
The standard namespaces carry fixed namespace indices
